note: 0.1.15: the meter across a compaction and a prompt sent. `compacted` shows from the compaction until the next main request starts (one Claude Code recorded, or an optimistic one), a keep-warm ping that read the cache, or prompt_cache moved past it; it has no time limit, as the context after a compaction is a fresh start. A main request Claude Code has not recorded yet (the transcript's last main request more than 5 s after the start prompt_cache has, at most 10 minutes old, not in the future, after any compaction) reads optimistically warm from its start (`0m`, `optimistic` true): no cold or compacted flash at a prompt, and on a warm cache the age starts again. Past 10 minutes such a request stops counting and the reading returns to prompt_cache's, or to compacted.

the same: --json label compacted, state cold, why compacted

the same: the plain line `cache compacted`
compacted 3 hours ago, idle since: still `compacted`
compacted, transcript only (no prompt_cache), past the expiry: still `compacted`
a prompt sent after the expiry, prompt_cache not yet updated: `0m` at once, not cold
the same: --json warm, optimistic, expiry from the request's start
the same: the plain line reads warm
the same, --short: `c 0m`
the same, --ascii: `------------ 0m`
the same, --color always: the normal warm colour, no `…`

after a compaction, a prompt sent after the old expiry: `0m`, not cold
the request's response recorded (prompt_cache from it): warm, 0m
the same: --json warm, no optimistic key

the same: --json optimistic, expiry an hour from the request

the same: --json cold, expired, not optimistic
a request started exactly 10 minutes ago: still optimistic, warm 10m

the 5-minute tier, its last request recorded and expired 100 s ago: cold
a compaction after the transcript's last request (never recorded): `compacted`
a keep-warm ping that read the cache after the compaction: warm
the same: --json warm, last a keep-warm ping, not optimistic

the transcript's request 6 s after prompt_cache's start (past the margin): a later request, optimistic
